d.ko: Make and share the most beautiful and bizarre medieval art imaginable! Manage and grow your manuscript workshop by illustrating manuscripts, using friendly tools and a massive range of drag-and-drop artworks from the deepest reaches of history. Welcome to your very own Scriptorium!

d.zh: 经营你自己的手稿工坊，接收各种订单，帮客户绘制中世纪书籍插画，怎么布置全凭你喜欢。完成后寄回给客户即可赚取报酬，还能解锁新工作、新装饰和各种物品。欢迎来到专属于你的中世纪缮写室！
